thread_text:
Sam: Heads-up: brought Mango the cockatiel for a desk cameo  he learned to mimic the standup bell, proceed with caution 
Priya: wait WHAT a bird that rings the meeting? please video now :laughing:
Sam: uploaded: <https://imgur.com/a/mango-visit|mango_bell.jpg> and short clip: <https://youtu.be/mango-ring>  he did three perfect dings and then a tiny laugh 
TK: this is a compliance hazard and also the best thing i've seen all week. will Mango accept an honorary meeting chair position? :raised_hands:
OpsBot: Reminder: guest pets must be registered. Birds require an enclosure when unattended and a short care sheet uploaded to the pet portal: https://intranet/pets. Please avoid startling noises near birds.
Sam: registered Mango and uploaded the care sheet. enclosure is on my desk; he gets supervised breaks. no squawk-related incidents yet :sweat_smile:
Leo: poll: Mango's best trick = 1) standup bell 2) microwave ding 3) "who left the lights on" whisper. react with :one:/:two:/:three:
Cassidy: reacts with :one: and :three:  can't decide between chaotic neutral and passive-aggressive office manager
Priya: posted a captioned gif: "Mango approves this sprint" and a pic of him wearing a tiny paper name tag that says "MANGO: QA" :bird:
TK: i will bring a tiny microphone prop tomorrow for Mango's debut. also volunteering to sew a miniature meeting cape. your co-host, TK :scissors:
Sam: note: Mango tends to mimic short phrases he hears most. please avoid repeating passwords or PII within earshot  bird eavesdropping is real :eyes:
OpsBot: Thanks for registering Mango, Sam. If Mango becomes a recurring visitor, please submit a recurring pet schedule form.
Cassidy: Mango nap update: he fell asleep to the sound of a very earnest standup. lunchtime photo drop incoming at 12:30 :camera_with_flash:
